item.description: Bhagavad Gita from Bhismadeva's Perspective. Lecture about Gita-Jayanti by HG Radhika Ramana Dasa in ISKCON of New JerseyGita Jayanti is the auspicious day of the advent of Srimad Bhagavad-gita. This is the day on which Lord Krishna imparted the essence of Vedic knowledge to Arjuna over 5000 years ago and enlightened him about the ultimate goal of life. item.description: By Seva Devi Dasi Devotees are not ordinary booksellers; their bookselling is transcendental. It is sankirtana, the glorification of Krsna, the Supreme Personality of Godhead. item.title: Principles for a harmonious marriage
item.description: By Radhanatha Swami Across all religions there is a universal concept that when a man and woman marry with proper attitude they become one body.
